projects.name: Thailand facility expansion
projects.quote: Our capital expenditures for 2024 were $170.9 million (2023 — $125.1 million), primarily to enhance our manufacturing capabilities in various geographies (including expansion of our Thailand and Malaysia facilities) and to support new customer programs.
